:::{#thm-vcov-outer-product}

#### The variance-covariance matrix of a random vector is the expected outer product of its deviations from its mean

For a $p \times 1$ [random vector](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $\vX = \tp{(X_1, \ldots, X_p)}$
with $\E{X_i^2} < \infty$ for every $i$,
the [variance-covariance matrix](#def-cov-vec-x) of $\vX$
[equals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix-equality) the [expectation of](expectation.qmd#def-expectation-matrix) the $p \times p$ [matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix)
formed by [multiplying](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrix-multiplication.html#def-matrix-mult) the [column vector](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-column-vector) $\vX - \Expp\vX$ by its own [transpose](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-transpose):

$$
\Varf{\vX} = \Expf{\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX} \tp{\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}}}
$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

Let $\mean_i = \E{X_i}$ for $i = 1, \ldots, p$,
so $\Expp\vX = \tp{(\mean_1, \ldots, \mean_p)}$.
Then:

$$
\ba
\Expf{
  \paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}
  \tp{\paren{\vX - \Expp\vX}}
}
&= \Expf{
  \pmat{X_1 - \mean_1 \\ \vdots \\ X_p - \mean_p}
  \pmat{X_1 - \mean_1 & \cdots & X_p - \mean_p}
}
\\
&= \Expf{
  \pmat{
    (X_1 - \mean_1)(X_1 - \mean_1) & \cdots & (X_1 - \mean_1)(X_p - \mean_p) \\
    \vdots                      & \ddots & \vdots                      \\
    (X_p - \mean_p)(X_1 - \mean_1) & \cdots & (X_p - \mean_p)(X_p - \mean_p)
  }
}
\\
&=
  \pmat{
    \Expf{(X_1 - \mean_1)(X_1 - \mean_1)} & \cdots & \Expf{(X_1 - \mean_1)(X_p - \mean_p)} \\
    \vdots                             & \ddots & \vdots                             \\
    \Expf{(X_p - \mean_p)(X_1 - \mean_1)} & \cdots & \Expf{(X_p - \mean_p)(X_p - \mean_p)}
  }
\\
&=
  \pmat{
    \Covs{X_1}{X_1} & \cdots & \Covs{X_1}{X_p} \\
    \vdots          & \ddots & \vdots           \\
    \Covs{X_p}{X_1} & \cdots & \Covs{X_p}{X_p}
  }
\\
&= \Varf{\vX}
\ea
$$

where:

- the first step writes out the entries of $\vX - \Expp\vX$,
- the second step multiplies the $p \times 1$ [column](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix-column) by the $1 \times p$ [row](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-matrices.html#def-matrix-row), entry by entry,
- the third step uses the [expectation of a random matrix](expectation.qmd#def-expectation-matrix), which is taken element by element,
- the fourth step uses @def-cov, and
- the last step uses @def-cov-vec-x.

:::
